data.rationale: The proposal has the same steps in the same order as the true workflow (Attractions, destination with suggestion, date, Search, optional filters, open the attraction, set guests/tickets and proceed), and its parameters line up, with "ticket quantities" standing in for guests; it is easy to automate, though the filter options and which result to open are not pinned down precisely.
